label: First Monday report calibration control by explicit controls
description: For a fair coin experiment and exactly one designated first-Monday assessment per experiment, every constant forecast report r has Heads conditional one half. A constant one-third report is therefore not calibrated for this designated cohort. The constant Sunday and constant first-Monday coin reports structurally retain one another in this reduced two-world model. This monitor control does not assume its information or reference class is Beauty's centered evidence. Proposed connection to epistemic warrant remains UNBUILT; reviewable synthesis in docs/notes/sleeping-beauty-1401.md.
